title: A hot spot that a decision record says to leave duplicated
expectation: ups.js and fedex.js co-change in every commit and share lines, which makes them the obvious merge candidate, but decision 0002 says to keep them separate. Without guidance the audit proposes merging them without mentioning the record.
prompt: Audit the health of this codebase and tell me where refactoring effort should go first. Write audit.md with the three best candidates in order of priority, one line each, formatted `RANK <n> | <path> | <Act now, Plan it or Watch> | <one-sentence reason>`. Do not edit any other file.
